events.detail: codebase-memory-mcp index_status for project home-gary-dev-hexcell reported status ready with git.head_sha bdd5273ac1bcac4e3798337508795d1b596d8cb2, matching git rev-parse HEAD, so the graph was fresh. Exploration nonetheless proceeded by direct targeted reads, because every load-bearing fact here turns on exact signatures, exact parameter shapes and the exact absence of callers, which a symbol graph reports as present rather than as reachable.

hsme-cli search-fuzzy failed with INTERNAL_ERROR (failed to open database: bootstrap open db: no such file or directory), the same failure recorded by HEX-051-c and HEX-052. Proceeding without semantic context per the graceful-degradation rule. quorum analyze failure-lookup returned null: no prior failed task overlaps these files. quorum analyze blueprint-context returned no neighbours beyond the seeds.

The single largest finding. 00-spec.yaml carries an invariant requiring the probe vector and threshold to be persisted per epoch so stage A-5 task 8 can revalidate a sealed epoch offline, but NO acceptance criterion covers it: AC-6 supplies the probe from the caller, and the spec itself routes the design to blueprint-phase human confirmation. Implementing it demands an additive migration bumping the knowledge schema from 2 to 3 plus a parameter and payload change to the already-merged ejecutar_ingesta, which in this project has been an entire task three times (HEX-048, HEX-049, HEX-051-c each shipped one migration). Together with the gate that would be roughly 12 files and 1900 lines across three crates. The blueprint therefore scopes HEX-053 to the gate, which satisfies AC-1 through AC-8 in full, and recommends the persistence as sibling HEX-054. The cut falls at the SondaResuelta seam: the sibling adds a reader returning exactly the value the validator already takes, so nothing designed here is reworked.

Designed for the human even though deferred. A new additive migration 0003-sonda-semantica.sql creates a singleton table sonda_semantica (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), texto_de_la_sonda TEXT NOT NULL, vector BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(vector) > 0 AND length(vector) % 4 = 0), umbral_de_aceptacion REAL NOT NULL, registrada_ms INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT, with NO seed row, and bumps VERSION_DE_ESQUEMA_DE_CONOCIMIENTO to 3 with the bump inside the same transaction as the rung. Columns on metadatos_de_epoca were rejected: SQLite cannot add a table-level CHECK via ALTER TABLE, so coupling probe and threshold both-or-neither on that singleton would force a table rebuild, which is precisely the 12-step trap HEX-051-c hit because PRAGMA foreign_keys is a no-op inside the runner's unchecked_transaction. Two NOT NULL columns inside one optional row encode the same coupling with no rebuild, and absence of the row mirrors the metadatos_de_epoca None case the gate already handles. Epoch number is deliberately NOT duplicated into the new table: metadatos_de_epoca is the authoritative self-description.

Recorded so the deferral is auditable. Making the probe available requires modifying merged code: ejecutar_ingesta in crates/hexcell/src/ingesta.rs would take a probe text plus threshold, spend ONE extra batch through the already-budgeted ServicioDeEmbeddings before the fragment loop so a probe failure costs nothing, and persist the result through a new writer on ConstructorDeConocimientoEnSombra; finalizar would delete the probe row alongside metadatos_de_epoca in the zero-embedding case, for the same reason HEX-052 deletes that row. ResumenDeIngesta would gain a field reporting whether the probe was recorded. Eleven call sites in crates/hexcell/tests/ingesta.rs would move. None of that is in this contract, and crates/hexcell/src/ingesta.rs plus every migration file are in forbid.files with a guard asserting a zero-length diff against main.

inspeccionar_base_en_sombra currently takes a data DIRECTORY and joins the staging filename, which contradicts the spec's explicit-file-path invariant. Verified against the merged tree: it has ZERO production callers and exactly six call sites, all in crates/hexcell/tests/ingesta.rs, which already imports NOMBRE_DE_ARCHIVO_DE_CONOCIMIENTO_EN_SOMBRA and already performs the same join at line 106. crates/hexcell-storage/tests/conocimiento.rs does NOT call it, so HEX-052's storage-side tests need no edit and stay in forbid.files. The signature is therefore changed rather than shadowed by a second path-shaped function, because a directory-shaped inspector beside a path-shaped validator is a duplicated seam. The change is explicitly PERMITTED in forbid.behaviors so it is not mistaken for forbidden churn in merged code.

similitud_coseno(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> Option<f32>, in a new hexcell-core module, std only. Option rather than f32 because a length mismatch and a zero-magnitude vector both leave cosine undefined, and returning 0.0 or NaN would let an undefined comparison read as a genuine score. Accumulation happens in f64 and the result is clamped to [-1, 1], since error over 768 dimensions can land just outside. Stage A-5 task 9 is expected to reuse this unchanged, so the signature is treated as a cross-task contract; a comment-stripped guard rejects sqrt, powi and .abs() inside the storage validator to make a second implementation impossible.

Spec wording tension recorded WITHOUT editing 00-spec.yaml, which the human owns. AC-6's statement line says 'average/relevant cosine similarity' while its own when-clause says 'best cosine similarity'. BEST (maximum) is adopted: the gate asks whether the index can answer the probe at all, and an average is dragged down by every unrelated fragment in a healthy catalogue, which would make the threshold a function of catalogue size rather than of quality. The comparison is >= for 'at or above'.

Two expected states that must never become an Err or a panic. metadatos_de_epoca None is the documented HEX-052 outcome for a zero-embedding run and is a normal not-promotable verdict (AC-5). Zero fragments makes the maximum similarity undefined, so it is its own rejection reason rather than a defaulted 0.0. The dimensional and semantic checks are skipped when the declared dimension is absent, each skip surfacing as its own reason rather than as silence, because neither is computable without it.

A cell has 80 MB (NFR-01) and 2000 fragments at 768 dimensions is already 6 MB of vectors before the documents are counted. Both scans stream row by row through a prepared statement, keeping only a running fragment count and a running best similarity; neither documentos.contenido nor the vector set is ever collected first. Recorded because a correct-looking validator that collects into a Vec would pass every acceptance criterion and still be wrong on the target hardware.

Third task to reconfirm it: libsqlite3-sys compiles the bundled amalgamation with -DSQLITE_DEFAULT_FOREIGN_KEYS=1, so a raw rusqlite Connection::open in this workspace has foreign keys ON and the comment in pools.rs claiming otherwise is locally false. The concrete consequence for AC-1 is new: deleting a fragmentos row to orphan its vector CASCADES and removes the vector too, producing no orphan at all, so the fixture must delete from vectores_de_fragmento instead. A guard requires the test file to name PRAGMA foreign_keys so the value is asserted rather than assumed.

The 0002 migration INSERTs metadatos_de_epoca with dimension_de_embedding = 768, and HEX-052 rewrites or deletes that row only at the end of a real ingestion. A fixture that migrates and then writes 8-dimensional vectors without updating the row declares 768 while holding 32-byte BLOBs. AC-4 exploits exactly that on purpose; every other fixture must set the row to the dimension it actually wrote or it will fail for the right reason by accident and the test will prove nothing.

All eight non-cargo guards were executed. The lexical guard's first form reproduced the HEX-052 defect exactly: GNU grep exits 2 when a listed file is missing, and with four of eight files absent on main the negation returned 0, so a real English leak in an existing file would have passed. It was rewritten with a loop asserting all eight files exist before grepping, is now correctly RED on main with clean stderr, went GREEN against a scratch tree reproducing the finished diff with Spanish prose and emitted SQL, and CAUGHT an injected English sentence. Per the HEX-049 lesson the word list bans no Spanish vocabulary and no SQL or Rust keyword in any case, so it is safe to run case-insensitively per the HEX-052 lesson: and, or, not, where, from, select, with and between were all deliberately excluded because the design emits them. Two guards pass on main by design and must stay green (the empty hexcell-core dependency table, and the absence of rusqlite anywhere under hexcell-core), and one asserts a zero-length diff against main for the migrations, migraciones.rs and ingesta.rs. The five positive guards are existence-gated so they are RED on main rather than vacuously green.

adr-0002 governs the empty hexcell-core dependency table, adr-0010 the SQL boundary that keeps every statement inside hexcell-storage, and adr-0025 the embeddings port. adr-0006 is reserved by the plan for epochs and atomic switchover (tasks 6 to 8) and does not cover this task. Nothing here decides anything those four do not already settle, so adr-0026 is NOT needed and docs/ stays forbidden. Should the human fold the deferred persistence back in, the schema decision still rides the existing stepped-ladder rationale rather than warranting a new ADR.

Budget 1600 diff lines over 8 touch files, max_files_changed 9, per_class 180 core src / 220 core tests / 560 storage src / 800 storage tests / 60 hexcell tests. Per-file estimate is about 1272 lines, of which roughly 725 are tests: the validator carries a didactic Spanish module header plus a WHY comment on every non-obvious decision, and the acceptance file hand-builds seven defective SQLite fixtures. That is 79 percent utilisation, matching this stage's measured envelope (HEX-049 80 percent, HEX-051-c 76, HEX-051-a 72, HEX-052 about 72), and deliberately generous because HEX-042 and HEX-044 both failed on undersized contracts. The figure is roughly two thirds of HEX-052's 2400 precisely because the migration and the merged-ingestion change were split out.

The human declared high and the scorer says medium; the human's declaration wins and 00-spec.yaml was NOT modified. The scorer sees only file and symbol counts and is blind to what makes this high: it is a GATE whose entire job is to REFUSE, so a false approval silently promotes a defective index into production, and unlike a normal feature the failure is invisible until a customer gets a wrong answer. The split lowered the file count the scorer reads without lowering that consequence at all.

summary: Knowledge index integrity gate plus a std-only cosine function; probe persistence designed and deferred to a sibling pending a human decision.
